items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: So now I'm with George E. Lee, and this is all like --

ctx.x: After I left Jesse STONE, see, the band finally broke up. I told you, and then Keg went to Minneapolis to join Eli Rice, and whatnot, right? And by this time I'm seeking a job.

So I told you we had met George E. Lee, and in Saint Joseph, Missouri, and they remembered me, and they dug the band, and everything, so one day I went by George E. Lee's rehearsal, and he wasn't there, so I just took my horn out and sat in his chair. So when he finally appeared I'm sitting in his chair playing. He say, "What, you came to take my job?" I said, "That's right." So he says, "Well then you've got it." 'Cause he played saxophone and sang.
So he just sang then, and let me play the saxophone, 'cause they liked the way I played. So now I'm with George E. Lee, and this is all like --
